question: What is the primary focus of tele-nursing within healthcare delivery?
explanation: Tele-nursing relies on digital communication tools to deliver direct nursing care and patient education remotely. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h1)

question: How does tele-health primarily benefit patients in rural Nigerian communities?

options.A: By reducing the need to travel far for basic care
options.B: By eliminating the need for any physical examinations
options.C: By replacing traditional doctors with computers
options.D: By providing free medications delivered to their door

explanation: Remote access to health services bridges geographical barriers, saving patients long and costly journeys to urban centres. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h1)

question: Which modality involves transmitting recorded medical images for a specialist to review later?
explanation: Store-and-forward technology allows clinical data and images to be saved and sent for offline review by another healthcare provider. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h2)

question: A diabetic patient uses a home device to send daily blood glucose readings to the clinic. What is this called?
explanation: Measuring and transmitting vital physiological signs from home using connected devices is classified as remote patient monitoring. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h2)

question: What is a primary duty of a nurse working in a tele-health setting?

options.B: Conducting virtual triage and symptom evaluation
options.C: Dispensing physical drugs directly via webcam

explanation: Tele-nurses frequently assess incoming calls or video feeds to determine the urgency of patient symptoms and direct them appropriately. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h3)

question: Why is digital literacy important for modern tele-nurses?

options.A: To market private health insurance products online
options.B: To replace physicians in diagnosing complex medical diseases
options.C: To effectively operate communication tools and manage virtual data
options.D: To write computer programming code for hospital software

explanation: Familiarity with software and hardware ensures seamless communication and accurate documentation during virtual patient interactions. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h3)

question: How must a tele-nurse adapt physical assessment techniques during a video consultation?

options.A: By relying exclusively on written text messages
options.B: By asking family members to perform the full diagnosis
options.C: By guiding the patient to perform self-checks under observation
options.D: By ignoring vital signs entirely until a clinic visit

explanation: When physical touch is impossible, nurses instruct patients to assist with basic examinations like palpation or inspection on camera. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h4)

question: What communication skill becomes especially critical when physical cues are limited on a call?
explanation: Active listening helps the nurse pick up tone changes, hesitations, and verbal cues that indicate patient distress or confusion. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h4)

question: Which body regulates the practice of professional nursing in Nigeria?

options.B: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria

explanation: The NMCN is the statutory body charged with the regulation and control of nursing education and practice in Nigeria. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h5)

question: Why is data encryption critical for virtual healthcare platforms in Nigeria?

options.A: To prevent patients from recording nursing instructions
options.B: To protect patient confidentiality and comply with privacy laws
options.C: To make video calls load faster on slow mobile networks
options.D: To reduce the cost of internet data bundles for clinics

explanation: Encryption safeguards sensitive health information from unauthorized access, maintaining ethical standards of patient privacy. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h5)

question: What is a major technical barrier to tele-health expansion in rural Nigeria?

options.A: An excessive surplus of modern computers
options.C: Universal free electricity in all communities
options.D: Poor internet connectivity and unstable power supply

explanation: Infrastructural deficits like erratic electricity and poor network coverage severely hamper reliable virtual care delivery. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h6)

question: Which of the following is a primary clinical benefit of implementing tele-health services?

options.A: Removal of the need for nursing documentation
options.B: Complete elimination of all hospital admissions
options.C: Improved healthcare access for remote populations
options.D: Lowering the salaries of specialized physicians

explanation: Tele-health successfully brings medical guidance and nursing expertise to patients who live far from urban hospitals. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T6#GNS113_U3_T6_h6)
